name: Done
use: Use after a save that closes a sheet and lands where the result is not visible: Record treatment or vaccination returning to the walk list.
notUse: Not where the result shows where you land (a finding sheet shows its treatment; the row itself says it), not for each entry inside a task, not for an upload that succeeds later, never for a failure.

name: Offline
use: Use for the same save made with no connection: the record is kept on this phone and uploads when connected.
notUse: Not as the only offline signal: the header badge carries "saved on this phone" after the toast has gone. Never says uploaded or synced.

name: Plain
use: Use only where a host has not yet been moved to a tone: Inspection's older saves ("Weights saved", "Saved to pen C1") draw the same box with a title and no glyph.
notUse: Not for new saves: give them a tone (done or offline) and a second line saying for whom.
